memory_update.text: PLTR remains the category reference leader for vertical AI automation/data-integration platforms; use it as a benchmark, not the main underfollowed alpha target.

node: Vertical AI automation software, proprietary data platforms, implementation services, compliance workflows, and industrial/defense AI systems
summary: Expanded the direct-public-company universe for the vertical AI automation/data-integration software node. Palantir is retained as the obvious reference leader because it anchors the category of operational AI platforms with government and enterprise workflow depth. The discovery lane emphasizes smaller US-listed companies with more concentrated exposure to enterprise AI applications, voice/customer-service automation, and defense/mission decision-intelligence workflows. Evidence strength is mixed: C3.ai, SoundHound AI, and BigBear.ai have direct AI positioning, but later layers must verify durable revenue quality, customer concentration, retention, gross margin trajectory, and whether deployments are mission-critical rather than AI-rebranding.
